lines.en: I take one step at a time, slowly.
Nobody knows where I am going.
My shadow sways.
My plates knock together.
I do not chase. I only shift.
Something drags behind me.
Two steps, then a stop.

lines.zh: 这条路我不知道通向哪。
lines.en: I do not know where this road goes.
My legs are heavy.
I graze along the wall.
I stop, then go on.
I am in no hurry. Let the hurried go.
I pass a pile of rotten planks.

lines.zh: 我立着，不知道在看什么。
lines.en: I stand, looking at nothing in particular.
The wind moves my cloth.
Two hundred pounds of me.
I seem to have forgotten something.
An insect crawls by my foot.
I stay still, and others stay still.
I turn half my face.

lines.zh: 风从我的布缝里穿过去，我听着。
lines.en: Wind passes through the gaps in my cloth; I listen.
I have stood here a long while.
Hands open and close. No movement.
The sky is grey.
I swallow once.
Two hundred health, and I can't be bothered.
I forget what I was thinking.

lines.zh: 我不认识你，可我记得你。
lines.en: I do not know you, yet I remember you.
Were you going to speak?

lines.zh: 我低头看你，布角垂到你脚边。
lines.en: I look down at you, my cloth hem at your feet.
Afraid of me? No need.
I cannot recall my own name.
You go that way, I go this.
I have words, and cannot get them out.
Your shadow is smaller than mine.

lines.zh: 我身上的布被抓出一道口。
lines.en: A tear is opened in the cloth on me.
I am not much for crying out.
A new dent in my plating.

lines.zh: 我两百点血，晃完还站着。
lines.en: Two hundred points of life; I sway and stay standing.
I lower my head and stare at the wound.
I forget what I was about to say.
Blood drips to the ground.

lines.zh: 我没有还手，只是把脚挪稳。
lines.en: I do not strike back; I only set my feet.
I never move. Don't hit me.
Can that be eaten?
I am not hungry, though...

lines.zh: 两百点生命，我却一步不动。
lines.en: Two hundred health, and I never move.
I will be slow about taking it.
Two hundred health, and I can't move.
I sniff for a long time.

lines.zh: 那东西在你手里，我够得着。
lines.en: That thing is in your hand, within my reach.
Thank you for staying.

lines.zh: 我的脚在地上陷了半寸。
lines.en: My feet have sunk half an inch into the ground.
That made a loud noise.
I give a very little.
I stand still and do not strike back.
Go around next time.

lines.zh: 别撞我，我这身数据还没加载完。
lines.en: Careful, my data hasn't finished loading.

lines.zh: 撞一下少一块像素，你赔得起吗？
lines.en: One bump and I lose a pixel. Can you afford that?

lines.zh: 我连站都懒得站，你却来撞我。
lines.en: I can't even be bothered to stand, and you bump into me.
I cannot remember who I am.
Say it from a step further.
I am too heavy for that.
Do not ask.
There is a hollow in me.

lines.zh: 这事以后再说，我先站着。
lines.en: We'll discuss that later. I'll stand here.
This cloth is too heavy; I turn slowly.

lines.zh: 两团脑腐凑一块，只会更糊涂。
lines.en: Put two pieces of brainrot together and it just gets more confused.
I bend down, slowly.
I thought it was something else.
I hold it, unsure whom to give it to.
I tuck it under the cloth.
There is more on the ground.
I drop it, and pick it up again.
This looks familiar.

lines.zh: 我拿起又放下，忘了为什么。
lines.en: I pick it up, put it down, and forget why.
Your hand is on the weapon.

lines.zh: 我抬起手臂，布下一片影。
lines.en: I raise my arm and a shadow falls from the cloth.
One step of mine.
Be careful.
I dislike being cornered.
The ground is covered in my prints.
This will not sound good.

lines.zh: 我锁定你了，虽然我根本不会动。
lines.en: I've locked onto you, even if I never actually move.
I waited three seconds.
The cloth on me rises and falls.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很慢，可每一步都沉。
lines.en: My steps are slow, but each one lands heavy.

lines.zh: 我抬起的手挡住了半边天。
lines.en: My raised hand blots out half the sky.

lines.zh: 没有目标的我，也在数脚步。
lines.en: Targetless, and still counting steps.
My cloth is stirring.

lines.zh: 我把手停在半空，等你抬头。
lines.en: I hold my hand in the air, waiting for you to look up.

lines.zh: 盯着你看，是我今天唯一的运动。
lines.en: Staring at you is the only exercise I get today.

lines.zh: 我掌心落下的地方土都压平。
lines.en: The soil flattens where my palm lands.
Slow, but heavy.
You are shoved back.
My knuckles graze you.
Only three blows.
I am still dazed.

lines.zh: 我的关节里像塞了砂石。
lines.en: My joints feel packed with gravel.
I will not chase you.
I stand where I should not.
I am here, for no reason.

lines.zh: 我想要点东西，忘了是什么。
lines.en: I wanted something. I forget what.

lines.zh: 很远的地方有人在叫我。
lines.en: Someone called me from far away.
Quieter here than where I was.
My head is heavy.
I do not know where to go.
I stop and look at you.
That was a long way.
Fire heats me through.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall and leave a crater.
I sink fast in water.
The blast shoves me far.
Something sticks in my shoulder.
That light muddles me further.

lines.zh: 我站着饿，忘了去找吃的。
lines.en: I stand here hungry, forgetting to look for food.
No ground here. I cannot stand.
